beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The system needs a credible route from detected error to changed understanding.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Tests must be capable of exposing a material mistake, rather than merely repeating procedure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Different fields build that resistance through different instruments, methods and communities.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book therefore defends correction without claiming one universal method settles every inquiry.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That foundation explains why its later architecture includes institutions as well as software.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: When implementation gets cheaper, preparing a research question can become more important.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Assumptions, evaluators and stopping conditions must be explicit before speed amplifies ambiguity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Finite observations also leave room for different explanations of the same data.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A model's confidence does not remove that problem or establish causal understanding.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book distinguishes structural limits from engineering problems that better methods might move.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That distinction helps readers avoid both magical optimism and unnecessary resignation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The practical opportunity is to design the interfaces where uncertainty can become visible.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book proposes an evidence-carrying research object as a durable record of inquiry.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Claims sit beside assumptions, data, code, decisions and reasons for previous changes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Negative results remain available instead of disappearing behind the final successful narrative.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The paper still matters as a signed, intelligible public view of that record.
